name: Park Medi World Ltd
title: Park Medi World Ltd - 544645 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Network occupancy rose to 64.1% for FY26 (Q4 62.5%) while capex is guided at ~INR500 crore over two years for 1,500 beds, a capital-light expansion with debt near zero.

utilisation.quote: The full-year occupancy was 64.1%, an improvement of 244 basis points year -on-year.

capex.peers_comment: Management said its nearest competitor's capex per bed would be more than double theirs.
capex.quote: Our nearest competitor would be more than double of this capex.

triggers.label: Occupancy 59.4% → 62.5% (Q4)
triggers.quote: Network occupancy for Q4 FY ’26 stood at 62.5% compared to 59.4% in Q4 FY ’25.

triggers.label: Capex ~INR500 cr for two years
triggers.quote: The total capex for next two years, two years is close to INR500 crores.

triggers.label: ARPOB +7% FY26 (Q4 +4%)
triggers.quote: So we registered a ARPOB growth of 7% as compared to last financial year.

triggers.label: IPD volume +18% FY26
triggers.quote: IPD volume stood at 95,525, up 18% year -on-year, and the highest in any year in our history.

guidance.quote: The company already having 1,500 beds under execution, those are expected to be operational by March 2028

guidance.value: CGHS net impact 5-6% of revenue; ~7-7.5% rate appreciation for nine months of FY27
guidance.quote: we see an appreciation of about 7%, 7.5%

guidance.value: Government insurance ~70%, private insurance ~30% by year-end
guidance.quote: hopefully that percentage will be 65 % coming from government insurance, it should be of 70% coming from government insurance
current year, we are expecting a top line, it will add about INR90 crores in our top line and it will become EBITDA positive.

red_flags.label: Receivables provision ~INR200 crore
red_flags.quote: the number is close to INR200 crores, the provision that we made on 31st March 2026.

red_flags.label: Disallowance ~9% of government revenue
red_flags.quote: we are remain at 9% disallowance, even in Q4.

red_flags.label: Debtor days 129 with 92% central govt exposure
red_flags.quote: if I talk about the total debtors, 92% relate to Central Government.

red_flags.label: Expenses benchmarked to revenue not ARPOB
red_flags.quote: please don't benchmark them to ARPOB alone.

evasions.quote: As far as cluster-wise basis is concerned, that we'll provide you once we're done with the call.
we have created … (inaudible) we have created provision , so everything is well on track.
please don't benchmark them to ARPOB alone.
